description: Check whether an entity in KRS is active and list risk signals found in its register entry: liquidation, bankruptcy, restructuring, arrangement, suspension, dissolution, tax and other arrears with enforcement, asset security, dismissed bankruptcy petition, court-appointed curator, missing board, overdue annual financial statements, and deletion from the register. Returns a compact report instead of the raw extract. The register (P/S) is optional – both are checked when omitted.

rejestr.description: Rejestr: P – przedsiębiorców, S – stowarzyszeń. Pomiń, aby sprawdzić oba rejestry.
